landing.title: Plan the trip together, not across five different chats.
landing.subtitle: Day-by-day itinerary, map, shared expenses and polls. Everyone sees changes the same second — and the link to the lodging stops getting lost in the thread.

how.title: Three steps to a plan everyone agrees on

1.title: Create a trip
1.text: Name, destination and dates. The itinerary days appear on their own — from the first to the last.

2.title: Send the link to friends
2.text: They sign in with Google, and you decide who edits and who only views.

3.title: Plan at the same time
3.text: Add stops, vote on lodging, log expenses. You can see who is changing what right now.

modules.title: Everything that usually ends up split between a spreadsheet, notes and a chat
modules.intro: Four sections of one trip. They are linked: a stop on the itinerary is a pin on the map, a topic for comments and maybe an expense.

itinerary.title: Itinerary
itinerary.text: Days and stops you can drag around. Notes, times and ticket links sit right next to the place they belong to.

map.title: Map
map.text: Every day has its own colour, every stop a number. You instantly see where the route loops and where to change the order.

budget.title: Budget
budget.text: Log who paid for what. At the end you get the shortest list of transfers to settle up in a minute.

discussion.title: Discussion
discussion.text: A trip chat with polls, and comments right on the stops. The argument about when to set off won’t get lost among the memes.
